mapper.insert: INSERT INTO study_plans (user_id, title, description, goal, duration, source_type, source_refs, status, phase_count) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{goal}, #{duration}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceRefs}::jsonb, #{status}, #{phaseCount})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, title, description, goal, duration, source_type, source_refs, status, phase_count, created_at, updated_at FROM study_plans WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND id = #{planId}
mapper.update: UPDATE study_plans SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{planId}
UPDATE study_plans SET phase_count = #{phaseCount}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{planId}
